title: Bluetooth connection issues AAPS 3.2.0.4 and Accu-Chek Insight pump and with Dexcom G7 CGM (Samsung A54B with Android 14)
symptom: The user reports frequent Bluetooth connection issues between AAPS and the Accu-Chek Insight pump and Dexcom G7 CGM on a Samsung A54B with Android 14, especially after a Samsung security update. An example shows a loss of pump connection for about 22 minutes despite the phone being approximately 1 meter away.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The user speculates that the issues may be related to Android 14 and the Samsung security update, and later suggests that Samsung's battery optimization (as described on dontkillmyapp.com) may be involved.
fix: The user reports that the issue was resolved by using Samsung's Good Guardians and Galaxy app booster, and following tips from dontkillmyapp.com to prevent the OS from killing background apps. The issue was closed as not reproducible after these optimizations.
evidence_quote: The issue has been resolved with one of the optimazations of the phone such as Good Guardians or Galaxy app booster. See more tips at https://dontkillmyapp.com/samsung
